name: TOOLS-GITHUB-ACTIONS-MONITOR-ANDROID
technologies: Read API v1 of GitHub Actions Monitor
notes: Scaffolding v0.0.1: the native Android client of GitHub Actions Monitor. It reads the read API v1 of a monitor with a bearer token kept sealed in the Android Keystore, shows the summary, the alerts, the repositories and the action proposals, lets a person approve or reject a proposal (the server enforces that a second person approves) and opens ghamon://proposal links. Push notifications are critical-only and OFF by default, and the Firebase side is a null implementation until a Google project exists. The rules are tested on the JVM; the app has not been built or run on a phone yet.
